svg.title: Anttila: daily GPP, Reco and gap-filled NEE (g C m-2 d-1), air temperature, soil water content and precipitation from 2022-01-01 to 2023-12-31, with the recorded management events. A dashed line marks a second date of the same event in another source.
svg.desc: Four panels on one date axis (local time, UTC+2) from 2022-01-01 to 2023-12-31. 730 days with gap-filled NEE; 65 days with a measured fraction of NEE below 10 % are drawn lighter. Daily GPP from −0.7 to 18.9, Reco from 0.0 to 10.1 and NEE from −10.6 to 6.0 g C m-2 d-1 (NEE < 0 = uptake). 8 recorded events in the period (4 harvest, 4 fertilisation), drawn as vertical lines with a type label above panel (a). 2 events lie outside the flux period and are not drawn: sowing 2021-06-03, harvest 2021-08-02. Largest change of daily GPP near each event: harvest 2022-06-21: GPP drop on 2022-06-22 (+1 d, clear); harvest 2022-08-08: GPP drop on 2022-08-08 (0 d, clear); harvest 2023-06-21: GPP drop on 2023-06-21 (0 d, clear); harvest 2023-07-19: GPP drop on 2023-07-21 (+2 d, not clear). Harvest 2022-08-08: the article source gives 2022-09-08; the largest GPP drop is on 2022-08-08 (0 d from the used date, −31 d from the other date), nearer to the used date. Grey bands: thermal growing season, 2022: 2022-05-09 to 2022-11-13 (188 d); 2023: 2023-05-07 to 2023-10-15 (161 d).
